gates: Refresh actual main and every original PR head immediately before a mutation.
Require complete successful applicable postmerge jobs for the actual main composition; missing, queued, skipped, failed, cancelled and timed-out required jobs are not passes.
If refs changed, inspect the unique delta and requalify rather than applying stale classifications.
Observe automatic PR state transitions before closing already-reconciled work.
Preserve original PR bodies, source refs, independent review records and historical qualification limits.
Make only the ordinary administrative close; no new runtime merge, branch deletion or shared-history rewrite.
